expectations.text: Auth check at the start of the route (getUser)
expectations.evidence: route.ts lines 97-109: Auth check with getUser() at the very start of POST handler. Logs error and returns 401 if auth fails.
route.ts lines 56-58: apiSuccess function wraps data in {success: true, data}. Lines 64-75: apiError wraps in {success: false, error: {code, message, message_tl, details}}

expectations.text: Tier-based model selection (Haiku for free, Sonnet for paid)
expectations.evidence: model-router.ts lines 76-96: selectModel function implements tier business rule: free=Haiku always, pro/business=smart routing. route.ts line 258: uses selectModel('ka_reasoning', tier)

expectations.text: Circuit breaker check before Claude API call
expectations.evidence: route.ts lines 239-252: Circuit breaker check happens before Claude API call. Line 275 starts the Claude API call after circuit check passes.

expectations.text: Retry with exponential backoff (max 3 retries) — must be a separate utility file
expectations.evidence: retry.ts is a separate file (lines 1-93). route.ts line 275 uses retryWithBackoff() wrapper. retry.ts implements exponential backoff with baseDelay * 2^attempt + jitter, max 3 retries (4 total attempts).

expectations.text: Conversation history stored to ka_conversations table
expectations.evidence: route.ts lines 388-430: Stores both user message (lines 389-398) and KA response (lines 408-421) to ka_conversations table with admin client.
route.ts lines 115-144: Validates body with ChatRequestSchema.safeParse(). Returns validation error if parsing fails. chat-schemas.ts lines 23-32 defines ChatRequestSchema.

expectations.text: Uses ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from server env, never exposed to client
expectations.evidence: route.ts line 271: process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY! is used only in server-side POST handler. No env key is sent to client in response.
